stages.label: Plan & budget
stages.gateLabel: Working budget, guest estimate and planning priorities recorded

stages.label: Venue & date
stages.gateLabel: Date and venue direction chosen with legal timing visible

stages.label: Celebrant & suppliers
stages.gateLabel: Essential suppliers researched, compared and deliberately selected or skipped

stages.label: Details & invites
stages.gateLabel: Guest communication, RSVP and day details are underway

stages.label: Final prep
stages.gateLabel: Final numbers, run sheet, balances and backup plans confirmed

stages.label: Wedding & after
stages.gateLabel: Day-of delivery and post-wedding close-out completed

tasks.title: Set a working wedding budget
tasks.whyItMatters: A working total makes supplier and guest trade-offs visible.

tasks.title: Estimate the guest count
tasks.whyItMatters: A working guest range affects venue capacity, catering and transport.

tasks.title: Confirm the wedding date
tasks.whyItMatters: An exact date turns planning windows into calendar dates.

tasks.title: Allocate the working budget by category
tasks.whyItMatters: Category targets prevent one commitment from silently consuming the whole budget.

tasks.title: Create the working guest list
tasks.whyItMatters: Named guests unlock invitations, RSVP tracking, meals and seating.

tasks.title: Confirm the ceremony format and location
tasks.whyItMatters: The ceremony format affects the celebrant, venue permissions and run sheet.

tasks.title: Select an authorised marriage celebrant
tasks.whyItMatters: The authorised celebrant receives the NOIM and confirms legal ceremony steps.

tasks.title: Give the NOIM to the authorised celebrant
tasks.whyItMatters: Federal law requires the authorised celebrant to receive it within the legal window.

tasks.title: Review supplier contracts and cancellation terms
tasks.whyItMatters: Written inclusions, deadlines and cancellation terms are the commitment evidence.

tasks.title: Record deposits and payment dates
tasks.whyItMatters: One payment projection keeps commitments and remaining cash visible.

tasks.title: Confirm vows and ceremony wording
tasks.whyItMatters: The celebrant needs time to review the ceremony structure and required wording.

tasks.title: Draft the seating plan
tasks.whyItMatters: A draft exposes household, access and relationship constraints before final numbers.

tasks.title: Review final supplier balances and receipts
tasks.whyItMatters: Payment evidence prevents missed balances and duplicate payment.

tasks.title: Archive final contracts, receipts and shared run sheets
tasks.whyItMatters: A complete record supports follow-up, disputes and post-wedding administration.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist venue
tasks.whyItMatters: The date and location constrain most later supplier and guest decisions. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist planner
tasks.whyItMatters: Full-service planners need runway before major supplier choices are locked. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist photographer
tasks.whyItMatters: Preferred photographers can have limited date availability. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist floral designer
tasks.whyItMatters: Design, seasonality and venue access need coordination. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist dj
tasks.whyItMatters: Music, equipment and MC responsibilities need a confirmed provider. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist band
tasks.whyItMatters: A full ensemble has more people, equipment and date constraints. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist caterer
tasks.whyItMatters: Menus, staffing, dietary needs and venue logistics take coordination. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist decor
tasks.whyItMatters: Design choices depend on the venue, palette and hire inventory. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist rental company
tasks.whyItMatters: Furniture and equipment inventory may be shared across events. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist videographer
tasks.whyItMatters: Preferred styles and teams can have limited date availability. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist marriage celebrant
tasks.whyItMatters: An authorised celebrant receives the NOIM and coordinates legal ceremony requirements. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist hair stylist
tasks.whyItMatters: Trials, travel and wedding-party coverage need a workable schedule. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist makeup artist
tasks.whyItMatters: Trials, travel and wedding-party coverage need a workable schedule. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist entertainment
tasks.whyItMatters: Specialist performers may have limited suitable dates. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist lighting company
tasks.whyItMatters: Power, rigging, access and venue approval can affect the design. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist cake baker
tasks.whyItMatters: Design, tasting, allergens, delivery and setup need confirmation. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist transport provider
tasks.whyItMatters: Vehicle capacity, routes, pickup times and overtime terms need confirmation. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist stationer
tasks.whyItMatters: Design, proofing, printing and postage need lead time. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist calligrapher
tasks.whyItMatters: Hand-finished pieces require guest details and production time. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist bartending service
tasks.whyItMatters: Licensing, staffing, stock and venue rules need coordination. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist ceremony ensemble
tasks.whyItMatters: Musicians, repertoire, equipment and ceremony cues need coordination. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist guest accommodation
tasks.whyItMatters: Room blocks and peak-date supply can affect travelling guests. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist attire designer
tasks.whyItMatters: Custom design, fittings and production require multiple stages. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist dress salon
tasks.whyItMatters: Ordering, delivery and alterations require multiple stages. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist alterations specialist
tasks.whyItMatters: Several fittings and a correction buffer may be needed. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist mc
tasks.whyItMatters: The MC needs time to understand the run sheet, people and tone. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist jeweller
tasks.whyItMatters: Sizing, engraving, custom work and delivery need a buffer. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist photo booth
tasks.whyItMatters: Equipment, attendants, access and custom artwork need confirmation. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist travel or honeymoon adviser
tasks.whyItMatters: Passports, leave, availability and seasonal planning may affect options. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist welcome amenity supplier
tasks.whyItMatters: Quantities, delivery locations and assembly need final guest information. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist specialist or emerging supplier
tasks.whyItMatters: Niche providers may have limited local supply and bespoke requirements. This is a planning estimate, so confirm availability and the supplier's own deadline directly.

tasks.title: Send save-the-dates
tasks.whyItMatters: Gives guests time to protect the date before detailed invitations are ready.

tasks.title: Publish wedding website and guest information
tasks.whyItMatters: Keeps travel, timing and RSVP information in one updateable place.

tasks.title: Send wedding invitations
tasks.whyItMatters: Starts the confirmed attendance and guest-detail workflow.

tasks.title: Close RSVPs and confirm final guest count
tasks.whyItMatters: Creates enough time to resolve missing replies before supplier final-number deadlines.

tasks.title: Confirm guest accommodation and transport information
tasks.whyItMatters: Lets guests plan reliable travel before the final weeks.

tasks.title: Confirm venue permits and event insurance
tasks.whyItMatters: Surfaces venue-specific approvals and cover before commitments become difficult to change.

tasks.title: Complete final outfit fitting
tasks.whyItMatters: Leaves a short correction window while keeping the final fit current.

tasks.title: Hold ceremony rehearsal
tasks.whyItMatters: Confirms entrances, cues and responsibilities with the people involved.

tasks.title: Confirm photographer shot list
tasks.whyItMatters: Gives the photographer time to validate timing, locations and essential groupings.

tasks.title: Complete final supplier confirmation sweep
tasks.whyItMatters: Finds timing, access and responsibility gaps while they can still be fixed.

tasks.title: Recheck weather and wet-weather plan
tasks.whyItMatters: Makes the backup plan explicit before the short-range forecast is available.

tasks.title: Apply for the official marriage certificate
tasks.whyItMatters: Keeps the post-wedding legal administration visible.

tasks.title: Send thank-you messages
tasks.whyItMatters: Closes the loop with guests and helpers while details are fresh.

tasks.title: Review wedding suppliers
tasks.whyItMatters: Records useful feedback after delivery can be assessed fairly.

tasks.title: Return hired items
tasks.whyItMatters: Avoids late charges and missing-item disputes.

tasks.title: Send the initial run-sheet draft to key vendors
tasks.whyItMatters: Tests feasibility before the master schedule is locked.
tasks.notes: Send the working run sheet to the photographer, caterer, venue manager and hair and makeup lead to confirm feasibility and timing.

tasks.title: Finalise run-sheet catering, speeches and transport times
tasks.whyItMatters: Connects supplier timing and guest movement in the same schedule.
tasks.notes: Confirm catering drop times, speech durations and transport pickup schedules.

tasks.title: Send the Final Master Run Sheet for vendor sign-off
tasks.whyItMatters: Creates one acknowledged version for third-party delivery.
tasks.notes: Send the final master version to every third-party vendor and ask them to confirm it.

tasks.title: Send the tailored VIP and wedding-party run sheet
tasks.whyItMatters: Gives each person only the timing and responsibilities they need.
tasks.notes: Share only getting-ready times, photo locations, transport and responsibilities with the wedding party and parents.

tasks.title: Prepare printed run-sheet copies for day-of leads
tasks.whyItMatters: Keeps the schedule usable if a device or connection fails.
tasks.notes: Provide printed copies to the venue manager, coordinator, photographer, DJ or MC and catering manager on the wedding day.
